english.legislation: Contrary to section 61(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
master / commander / owner of a ship / aircraft

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 61(5)(a) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that the goods shall be liable to be forfeited.
(ii) Section 61 was amended by Schedule 7 to the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2020, brought into force on the 31st December 2020 by SI 2020/1642. For any offences committed on or after the 31st December 2020, see offence wording document H100135 (CJS code CE79356).
